mutations.contract: The node test admits a face only when its nodes sit on one cylinder to the float32 resolution of its coordinates (cylinderNodeUlps). mutations.note: The mutation deletes the resolution bound and keeps every other gate, which is the version that trusts the 2 percent radial test the facet path already uses.
mutations.find: if (fit.maxResidual > tol.cylinderNodeUlps * magnitude * FLOAT32_RESOLUTION) return null;
